plan_schema.name: ldfreq.ellipse.confirmatory-analysis-plan
plan_schema.description: Machine-readable preregistration for the ELLIPSE external-association analysis. This file contains no essay text, writer identifier, essay identifier, or individual prediction.

purpose.primary: Evaluate whether the prespecified TUBELEX type-weighted frequency and channel-prevalence block adds unknown-prompt information about ELLIPSE human Vocabulary ratings beyond text length, MTLD, and an NGSL Beyond-K2 control.
purpose.product_boundary: This is an external-association audit of descriptive text metrics, not development of a scoring product.

research_questions.question: Does the two-metric TUBELEX focal block improve leave-one-prompt-out macro-MAE for Vocabulary beyond the fixed baseline model?
After prompt adjustment, are lower type-weighted TUBELEX Zipf frequency and lower type-weighted channel prevalence associated with higher Vocabulary ratings?
Does the same fixed model show association with Overall ratings?
How do associations with the other five analytic ratings differ descriptively from the association with Vocabulary?

data.corpus: English Language Learner Insight, Proficiency and Skills Evaluation (ELLIPSE) Corpus

preflight_gates.requirement: All primary-file SHA-256 values match this plan.
The final data contain 6482 records, 6482 unique essay IDs, 44 prompt labels, complete text/prompt/Vocabulary fields, and the expected Vocabulary scale.
The analysis commit, dependency lockfile, resource manifests, resource hashes, and all metric parameters are recorded before outcome analysis.
The frozen tool commit passes its computational and resource-verification test suite.
Feature computation, missingness checks, variance checks, and collinearity diagnostics are completed without using outcome values or outcome-feature associations.
Network access, telemetry, external logging, and external API access are disabled while human essays are processed.

controls.construct: share of normalized heads beyond the first two NGSL thousand bands, including off-list items

focal.construct: type-weighted Beta(1,1)-smoothed log10 TUBELEX channel prevalence

excluded_from_confirmatory_selection.reason: Avoid outcome-driven choice and redundant diversity testing beyond the prespecified MTLD control.
No sufficiently specific directional confirmatory hypothesis for the ELLIPSE Vocabulary rating.
Reserved for exploratory reporting to keep the confirmatory set small.

selection_rules.if_vif_exceeds_limit: Retain both focal metrics for the prespecified block comparison, do not claim independent metric-specific contribution, and report single-focal models only as sensitivity analyses.

association_model.coefficient_unit: Vocabulary rating points per one predictor standard deviation

primary_endpoint.practical_reference_rationale: One tenth of the smallest observed 0.5-point outcome step.

secondary_endpoints.definition: Unweighted mean over prompts of each prompt's root mean squared prediction error.
Mean absolute prediction error over all held-out essays, so prompts contribute in proportion to essay count.
Root mean squared prediction error over all held-out essays, so prompts contribute in proportion to essay count.
One minus the sum of held-out squared errors divided by the sum of squared deviations from the corresponding training-fold outcome mean.

sensitivity_analyses.change: Fit Vocabulary as nine ordered categories using a cumulative-logit specification.
Restrict to essays with at least 50 TUBELEX lookup tokens and 20 lookup types.
Fit the association model with equal total weight per prompt.
Replace both focal type-weighted TUBELEX metrics with their token-weighted counterparts.
Replace type-weighted channel prevalence with type-weighted video prevalence.
Replace the three-degree-of-freedom length spline with a linear log-length term.
Replace tool n_tokens with the audited ELLIPSE num_words column.
Add grade, gender, race_ethnicity, and SES using complete cases; do not interpret these coefficients causally.
Exclude essays below the first or above the ninety-ninth percentile of tool n_tokens.
Fit on the provided train set and evaluate on the provided test set as known-prompt sensitivity only.
Repeat coefficient estimation while omitting each prompt in turn and report the coefficient and delta-MAE ranges.
If focal VIF exceeds 10, fit one fixed single-focal model per TUBELEX metric without selecting between them by outcome performance.

stop_rules.trigger: Any audited data hash, record count, prompt count, required field, or outcome scale differs from this plan.
stop_rules.action: Stop before confirmatory estimation; investigate and issue a dated plan amendment before any rerun.

stop_rules.trigger: Human essay text, identifier, individual feature row, or individual prediction may have reached an external API, telemetry system, external log, or public artifact.
stop_rules.action: Stop immediately, treat as a privacy incident, and invalidate the confirmatory run.

stop_rules.trigger: A focal implementation must change, metric missingness reaches one percent, a prompt is lost, or the prespecified design matrix is singular.
stop_rules.action: Stop; do not substitute another metric. Version any corrected analysis as an amended plan.

stop_rules.trigger: A result is null, weak, unfavorable, or opposite to the expected direction.
stop_rules.action: Do not add metrics, change models, exclude cases, or rerun as confirmatory; report the result as an interpretation boundary.

stop_rules.trigger: Layer 3 work exceeds ten working days or would delay the public v1.0 release.
stop_rules.action: Defer the ELLIPSE analysis and continue the public-tool release path.

allowed: The prespecified metrics were or were not associated with noisy human Vocabulary ratings in this audited ELLIPSE sample.
The fixed TUBELEX block did or did not add unknown-prompt predictive information within the ELLIPSE population under 44-fold leave-one-prompt-out evaluation.
Effect sizes and uncertainty are conditional on the frozen tokenizer, normalizer, reference resources, parameters, prompts, and sampled population.
prohibited: The tool directly measures writer vocabulary knowledge, CEFR level, writer proficiency, or writing quality.
The associations are causal or imply that changing a metric will improve human ratings.
TUBELEX prevalence is a direct measure of familiarity, educational desirability, or word quality.
ELLIPSE leave-one-prompt-out performance guarantees generalization to adults, L1 writers, speech, academic genres, other corpora, or other populations.
The Vocabulary rating is an error-free gold standard.
The fitted evaluation model should be distributed, deployed, or exposed as an individual scoring feature.
claim_boundaries.null_result_policy: Publish the null or weak result as a boundary on interpretation; do not block the tool release.
